verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a virtual-mailbox SaaS, and any SaaS can publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies. A probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404), and no first-party docs mention agent-oriented documentation. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on all candidate paths, but that covers a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
